# MarketNow — Security Infrastructure for AI Agents

MarketNow is AliceLabs' security and trust infrastructure for AI agents. Sentinel provides security/trust signals; the catalog is the discovery layer. Catalog entries are not guarantees of safety.

## Machine-readable discovery

- MCP server card: https://marketnow.site/.well-known/mcp.json
- Agent discovery: https://marketnow.site/api/agent.json
- API manifest: https://marketnow.site/api/manifest.json
- MCP endpoint: https://marketnow.site/api/mcp
- Paginated catalog: https://marketnow.site/api/skills
- UTA/trust API: https://marketnow.site/api/trust
- Revocation/OCSP: https://marketnow.site/api/ocsp and https://marketnow.site/api/crl

## Remote MCP

Transport: Streamable HTTP
Endpoint: https://marketnow.site/api/mcp
Protocol advertised by the server: MCP 2025-03-26

Tools:
- marketnow_verify_trust
- marketnow_translate_credential
- marketnow_list_formats
- marketnow_get_pipeline
- marketnow_check_domain
- marketnow_search_skills
- marketnow_check_revocation
- marketnow_fingerprint_tool
- marketnow_submit_skill

The stdio package is installed with:

    npx -y marketnow-mcp

## Catalog

The canonical machine-readable statistics are served by MarketNow and may change over time. Do not rely on hard-coded counts in third-party copies.

Current published snapshot:
- Index-certified skills: 69,077
- Tracked entries across sources: 133,426
- Categories: 16
- Sentinel certificate scores available: 16,366
- npm Sentinel scan: 2,839 tarballs, 29 rules, 885 clean, 791 warning, 1,156 error

Use GET https://marketnow.site/api/skills?page=1&limit=100 for paginated discovery. Prefer the API over downloading the legacy full catalog.

## Trust and verification

MarketNow exposes Sentinel/ATC trust signals and the Universal Trust Adapter (UTA). Verification is fail-closed where cryptographic verification is applicable. A catalog listing or score is not a guarantee that a third-party skill is safe.

Supported credential formats exposed by UTA include:
- ATC v3
- JWT
- W3C VC
- A2A Agent Card
- EAT-AI
- ZTA
- MCP Card
- X.509

## Security notes

- MCP tool definitions can be fingerprinted with RFC 8785 JCS + SHA-256 using marketnow_fingerprint_tool.
- Revocation can be checked for an ATC card ID or CA key ID.
- Skill submissions are validated and Sentinel-scanned before entering the submission workflow.
- Do not send private keys, API tokens, passwords, or other secrets to MarketNow APIs.
